svg.title: Component diagram: the page of the workbench
svg.desc: The page has seven components. The client of the hub connects to the workbench process through the link, with an output subsystem and an input subsystem. The renderer reads the part store from the output port and sends inputs through the input port. It finds the view in the table of views, and mounts it with props. A view sends an input through the prop wishem. The table collects the views and reads the sidecars. The views draw with the catalog. The product panel reads the part product from the output port and sends product/set-field through the input port, and it draws with the catalog.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
